content.value: Write short notes from the followings (any five):
(i) Land use clearance and deviation in plans and constructions.
(iii) Team of experts and professionals engaged in updating the BNBC 1993.
(iv) Sources of fund for a municipality.
(v) Declaration of city area under the Pourashava Ordinance 2010.
(vi) Establishment of a municipality under the Pourashava Ordinance 2010.
(vii) Erection and re-erection of buildings under Pourashava Ordinance, 2010.
